title: Spex Machina Module
description: Schema for a module-level spec file (module.json). Defines module metadata, requirements, architecture components, data flows, test sections and apis.

components.description: Architecture components with content links and cross-references.

test_sections.description: Test sections describing module integration and acceptance tests for components.

apis.description: External surface entry points this module provides (CLI subcommands, HTTP routes, library entry points).

requirement.$comment: Module-level requirement. Extends the project-level requirement with preq_id to trace derivation from project requirements. IDs are 12-char hex identity hashes computed by schema.IdentityHash. name (renamed from title in spec format version 1) makes the envelope universal across every node type.

id.description: Identity hash ID (12-char hex), unique within the requirements array.

preq_id.description: Identity hash of the project requirement this module requirement derives from.

depends_on.description: Identity hashes of other requirements this one depends on (depends_on edge).

id.description: Identity hash ID (12-char hex), unique within the components array.

content.description: Relative path to the markdown content leaf (described_in edge to content leaf).

implements.description: Requirement identity hashes this component implements (implements edge).

uses.description: Identity hashes of other components this one depends on (uses edge).

id.description: Identity hash ID (12-char hex), unique within the test_sections array.

content.description: Relative path to the markdown content leaf (described_in edge to content leaf).

describes.description: Component identity hashes described by this test section (describes edge).

id.description: Identity hash ID (12-char hex), unique within the data_flows array.

content.description: Relative path to the markdown content leaf (described_in edge to content leaf).

uses.description: Component identity hashes involved in this data flow (uses edge).

api.$comment: An external surface entry point. No content file — an api hashes from these fields alone. Identity is <module>/api/<name>, computed by schema.IdentityHash.

id.description: Identity hash ID (12-char hex), unique within the apis array.

provided_by.description: Identity hashes of components in this module that provide this entry point (module-local).

group.description: Freeform grouping label for renderers (e.g. "cli", "http"). Spex never branches on it.
